title: Dynamics 365 Sales: ask Sales agent about opportunity research in Microsoft 365 Copilot
summary: Hold: the briefing says the arrival state is unstated although the roadmap says administrators or makers enable the capability for end users. It also says the roadmap does not name the research agent, although the title identifies Sales Opportunity Agent insights. The access controls and most supporting product facts are documented.

claims.where: Cost and licensing; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: Graph-grounded data such as Outlook emails and Teams meetings requires a Microsoft 365 Copilot licence.

claims.claim: In the Sales app in Outlook or Teams, Sales > Settings > Tenant > Access settings > Allow access to Sales agent > Microsoft 365 Copilot reaches the application access toggle.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance controls
claims.claim: Tenant access settings require Global Administrator, Exchange Administrator or Power Platform Administrator.
claims.quote: You must have one of the following Microsoft Entra roles: Global Administrator; Exchange Administrator; Power Platform Administrator

claims.claim: Dynamics 365 administrator settings require System Administrator or System Customizer.
claims.quote: Dynamics 365: You must have the System Administrator or System Customizer role. If you're using a custom security role, you might need more privileges to use the Sales agent.

claims.claim: Administrator settings are visible only to administrators signed in to Sales agent in Outlook or Teams.
claims.quote: Administrator settings are visible only when you sign in with administrator credentials to the Sales agent in Outlook or Teams.

claims.claim: Tenant access settings do not install the app.
claims.quote: These settings control access only. They don't install apps, assign licenses, connect to a CRM environment, or grant access to CRM data.

claims.claim: Tenant access settings do not grant CRM data access.
claims.quote: Tenant access settings don't grant access to CRM data and don't override licensing, environment, or security requirements.

claims.claim: Tenant access does not override environment Sales Chat access, installation, licensing or CRM privileges.
claims.quote: Tenant access settings don't override other Sales agent requirements.

claims.claim: Access is evaluated per application using Entra security groups and Restrict auto-installed users.
claims.quote: If the application is turned off, access is blocked. If No restrictions is selected, access is allowed. If the user received Sales agent through automatic installation and Restrict auto-installed users is selected, access is blocked.

claims.claim: The existing environment Sales agent access control is turned on for all users by default.
claims.quote: By default, Sales agent is turned on for all users. You can choose to restrict access to specific security groups or turn off the feature entirely.

claims.where: Why it matters; Governance guidance: Before rollout

claims.quote: Microsoft 365 Copilot | Sales agent remains visible but displays an administrator-disabled message.

claims.quote: users who have Sales agent installed will still see Sales as an agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot. They can still ask questions and get responses, but the responses will not include any Sales data.
